title: D-045 B2 connector build: DCM Street Center Line street-width connector (ArcGIS primary, fail-closed-to-narrow width classification)
objective: Build the street-width / mapped-street data connector pinned to the accepted M4-T013 research (project-control/reports/M4-T013-street-width-research.md): a NEW focused connector module for the DCM Street Center Line ArcGIS feature service (DCM_Street_Center_Line/FeatureServer/0, DCP_GIS, keyless, EPSG:2263 native) as PRIMARY source, with the SODA g6zj-tzgn channel documented as the stale fallback and Geoclient per-address streetWidth KILLED for legal use (paved width, not mapped width - research section 5). Central obligation: the authoritative Streetwidth field is FREE TEXT (ranges, inequalities, approximations, prose, irregular, n/a, unknown - research E7), so the connector implements a conservative typed classifier that emits wide ONLY where the raw value MATHEMATICALLY entails width >= 75 ft (the ZR 12-10 threshold), and fails closed to narrow on every other class, carrying the typed ambiguity class and a review flag - never a guessed or interpolated number. Mapped-street status (Feat_type/Feat_status/Record_ST/Paper_ST) surfaces as typed fields; paper/record/unmapped segments never classify wide. Recorded-official fixtures (verbatim live-captured bytes + MANIFEST provenance), fully offline tests via an injected fetch seam, HTTP-200-error-object trap, exceededTransferLimit paging, bounded predicates only (thin client). Registry draft updated per the M2-T009 posture. The downstream consumer (R6-R8 wide-street conditional rule / A2 geometry mechanics) is NOT wired in this task; OQ-1/OQ-3 stay open legal questions the connector surfaces but never resolves.
business_reason: D-045-R003 names the B2 street-width connector as the A2 dependency; the research-first half (M4-T013) is accepted - this is the build half, running parallel with M4-T012 under D-046/D-047 wave discipline with fully disjoint scope.

risks: free-text width parsing is the chief hazard: an over-permissive parser would silently raise FAR eligibility downstream; the mathematical-entailment rule + exhaustive typed-class tests are mandatory; any doubtful class fails closed to narrow
OQ-1 (exact geometric definition of DCM mapped width) and OQ-3 (ZR-grounded ambiguity policy) are OPEN legal/rule questions - the connector surfaces classes and flags, never resolves them
SODA fallback is ~16 months stale - any fallback documentation must carry the staleness caveat; currency comes from the ArcGIS dataLastEditDate pin

path_notes: CONNECTOR-DISCIPLINE CLONE (M5-T020/M2-T009): new focused modules only; every existing connector is READ-ONLY (forbidden); reuse public patterns by import where applicable, never copy-paste forks and never edits. WIDTH SEMANTICS: DCM records the MAPPED (Official City Map) width - the ZR 12-10 concept; Geoclient streetWidth is PAVED width, killed for legal use (research section 5) - do not wire it even as an advisory in this task. CLASSIFIER DIRECTION: a wide-street determination only ever RAISES FAR downstream, so the connector NEVER emits wide except on mathematical certainty from the raw text; everything else is narrow_fail_closed + typed class + review flag, preserving the rules layer's conservative posture. MEASUREMENT CRS: EPSG:2263 native (outSR=2263); display-transport reprojection is out of scope here. THIN CLIENT: KB-scale bounded captures only, no bulk datasets. DISJOINTNESS (D-046-R002): allowed_paths share nothing with M4-T012 (rules dirs, _zr_snapshots, tests/rules, its reports) - pairwise-disjoint by construction. PRODUCER MODEL (D-047-R001): claude-sonnet-5; the backend-engineer agent-file model-key flip was blocked by the session permission classifier (Edit and PowerShell both denied) - the dispatch carries the harness model override resolving to claude-sonnet-5 and this deviation is recorded here and in the progress log; the durable agent-file flip is an open owner/settings item; escalation per D-047-R003 on two review failures. WORKTREE: producer works in its own worktree reset to the task base on candidate/D-024-mrl-option-b; primary checkout is orchestrator-only.
